transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Identity is the select config option with category model. providerModelId is currentValue. displayName is the matching choice name when present.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: A config_option_update with no model selector retracts monitor key observed. The pipeline instead emits adapter:native-event and does not retract.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: Monitor intent is always the literal observed. The pipeline model:updated omits intent.
